name: Mombasa
blurb: Mombasa remains one of the most discussed destinations in the country, with steady volume across the period and no unusual movement.

positive: Easy to get around without a car
Quieter than the better-known spots nearby
negative: Cheap accommodation getting harder to find
Prices noticeably up on last season

quotes.text: The food alone would be worth the trip.
Second time here and it still feels underrated.
Spent a week here working remotely, wifi was fine everywhere.
